difficultyRationale: Checks the implicit readability foundation that module declarations usually do not spell out.
prompt: For a named module other than `java.base`, which dependency is implicitly present even when it is not written in `module-info.java`?
explanation: Every module other than `java.base` implicitly depends on `java.base`, so ordinary module declarations do not need to write that requires directive.

options.explanation: java.base is implicitly required by every other named module.
java.desktop is needed only when a module actually depends on its APIs.
The implicit dependency is not an implicit transitive re-export.
